readmeMarkdown:
floating-loop

Autonomous Ralph-inspired iterative loops, keep-or-revert autoresearch, and parallel multi-agent worktree swarms built natively for Google Antigravity (agy)
Because in Antigravity, loops float.

--- ## What Is Floating Loop? `floating-loop` evolves the classic [Ralph Wiggum autonomous loop](https://ghuntley.com/ralph/) (`snarktank/ralph` + `claude-ralph-loop`) for Google Antigravity's native customization and orchestration primitives — adding mechanical verification, circuit breakers, context-rot telemetry, keep-or-revert metric optimization, and parallel Git worktree DAG swarms with **zero external dependencies**. ### Why Floating Loop vs. Classic Ralph Loops? | Capability | Classic Ralph Loop | `floating-loop` | | --- | --- | --- | | **Completion Integrity** | Trusts `` text alone | **Dual-Gate Verification**: independently runs `verifyCommand` and rejects premature promises or fake `passes: true` | | **Stall & Error Protection** | Loops until max iterations | **3-State Circuit Breaker** (`CLOSED -> HALF_OPEN -> OPEN`) on zero-diff stalls or repeated identical errors | | **Context-Rot Defense** | None (in-session degrades silently) | Reads `input_tokens + cache_read_tokens` from Antigravity `transcript.jsonl` and pauses cleanly at ceiling | | **Parallel Execution** | Sequential single-agent only | **Parallel Worktree DAG Swarm** (`dependsOn` waves in `workspace="share"` worktrees + `pro`-tier Adversarial Verifier) | | **Optimization Loops** | Feature tasks only | **Autoresearch Keep-or-Revert Mode** (`results.tsv` + automatic `git reset --hard` on metric regression) | | **Retry Intelligence** | Same model every attempt | **Role Hats & Model/Effort Cascade**: steps up model/effort automatically when verification fails | | **Active-Loop Safety** | Relies on prompt instructions | **`PreToolUse` Guardrail**: blocks `rm -rf /`, `git push --force`, unauthorized `git reset --hard`, and state tampering | | **Upstream Migration** | Start from scratch | **Mid-Run Takeover**: resume active `claude-ralph-loop` or `snarktank/ralph` runs without losing progress | --- ## Which Mode Should I Use? | Mode | Best For | Context | Entrypoint | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Mode A — In-Session `Stop` Hook** | Fast interactive bug-fixing & test polishing | Shared session (with token ceiling) | `hooks.json` + `scripts/loop-ctl.py start` | | **Mode B — Fresh-Context CLI (`prd` / `prompt`)** | Multi-story overnight feature builds | Fresh `agy -p` per iteration (zero rot) | `./scripts/floating-loop.sh --mode prd` | | **Mode B — Autoresearch** | Optimizing latency, bundle size, score, or benchmarks | Fresh `agy -p` + keep-or-revert | `./scripts/floating-loop.sh --mode autoresearch` | | **Mode C — Worktree DAG Swarm** | Large PRDs with independent parallelizable stories | Isolated `workspace="share"` worktrees | `floating-swarm` skill -> `floating_swarm.py` | | **Mode D — Live `/swarm` Playbook** | Exploratory, cross-cutting epics needing coordination | Shared Antigravity `/swarm` board | `floating-swarm` skill | | **Takeover** | Migrating an in-progress `claude-ralph-loop` or `snarktank/ralph` run | Preserves state, branch & `progress.txt` | `scripts/loop-ctl.py takeover` | --- ## Installation ### Prerequisites - [Google Antigravity CLI (`agy`)](https://antigravity.google/docs/getting-started/) installed and authenticated ([download Antigravity](https://antigravity.google/download)) - Python `3.8+` (stdlib only — no `pip install`, `jq`, or Node required) - `bash` 3.2+ and `git` ### Install from the Antigravity Plugin Marketplace Partner install id: `floating-loop@antigravity-plugins-partners` ```bash agy plugin install floating-loop@antigravity-plugins-partners ``` Or open [Floating Loop in the Antigravity Marketplace](antigravity://customizations/marketplaces/antigravity-plugins-partners/plugins/floating-loop) (**Customizations → Marketplace**). The catalog card is on the [Marketplace plugins page](https://antigravity.google/docs/marketplace/?plugin=floating-loop#browse-marketplace-plugins). ### Install from GitHub ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/Lepida-io/floating-loop ``` ### Local Development / Clone ```bash git clone https://github.com/Lepida-io/floating-loop.git cd floating-loop agy plugin validate . --strict agy plugin install . ``` Verify the plugin is installed and enabled: ```bash agy plugin list ``` --- ## Quickstart ### 1. Author a PRD & Convert to `prd.json` Inside `agy`, ask Antigravity to use the `prd` skill to plan your feature (`tasks/prd-.md`), then run `prd-to-loop` to produce a validated, dependency-tagged `prd.json`. ### 2. In-Session `Stop` Hook Loop (Mode A) ```bash python3 scripts/loop-ctl.py start \ --cwd "$(pwd)" \ --conversation-id "" \ --max-iterations 15 \ --completion-promise "DONE" \ --verify-cmd "pytest -q" \ --prompt "Fix all failing tests in tests/auth/ without skipping any assertions." ``` Monitor, reset, or stop at any time: ```bash python3 scripts/loop-ctl.py status --cwd "$(pwd)" python3 scripts/loop-ctl.py cancel --cwd "$(pwd)" python3 scripts/loop-ctl.py reset-cb --cwd "$(pwd)" ``` ### 3. External Fresh-Context CLI Loop (Mode B — Zero Context Rot) ```bash # Preview assembled prompt & command without side effects ./scripts/floating-loop.sh --mode prd --prd examples/prd.json.example --dry-run # Run overnight PRD loop (auto-escalates model/effort on verification failure) ./scripts/floating-loop.sh \ --mode prd \ --prd prd.json \ --max-iterations 20 \ --cb-threshold 3 ``` ### 4. Autoresearch Keep-or-Revert Loop (Metric Optimization) ```bash ./scripts/floating-loop.sh \ --mode autoresearch \ --goal "Minimize JSON parser p95 latency" \ --metric-cmd "python3 bench/p95.py" \ --direction minimize \ --verify-cmd "pytest -q" \ --max-iterations 15 ``` Improvements are kept and logged to `results.tsv`; regressions or broken tests are automatically reverted via `git reset --hard`. ### 5. Mid-Run Takeover from Upstream Ralph Loops Resume an in-progress `claude-ralph-loop` (`.claude/ralph-loop.local.md`) or `snarktank/ralph` (`prd.json` + `progress.txt`) run directly in Antigravity: ```bash python3 scripts/loop-ctl.py takeover \ --cwd "$(pwd)" \ --verify-cmd "npm run typecheck && npm test" ``` - Imports exact `iteration`, `max_iterations`, `completion_promise`, and prompt from `.claude/ralph-loop.local.md` (archiving the old file so hooks never collide). - Preserves existing `progress.txt`, `ralph/` branch, and `passes: true` stories from `snarktank/ralph`, surfaces interrupted uncommitted edits and `CLAUDE.md` notes, and auto-serializes legacy `dependsOn`-less PRDs inside `floating_swarm.py`. ### 6. Parallel Worktree DAG Swarm (Mode C — `run_workflow`) Ask Antigravity to activate the `floating-swarm` skill, which validates your `prd.json` waves and invokes `run_workflow` on `scripts/workflows/floating_swarm.py` — fanning out independent stories in `workspace="share"` worktrees and gating merges behind an independent `pro`-tier Adversarial Verifier. --- ## Architecture ```text floating-loop/ # Native Antigravity plugin root ├── plugin.json # Plugin manifest (Marketplace + `agy plugin install`) ├── assets/ │ └── logo.svg # 128×128 transparent Marketplace icon ├── hooks.json # Antigravity Stop + PreToolUse lifecycle hooks ├── rules/ │ └── AGENTS.md # Loop discipline, promise integrity, backpressure rules ├── skills/ │ ├── floating-loop/SKILL.md # Core controller (Modes A, B, Autoresearch, status/cancel) │ ├── floating-swarm/SKILL.md # Multi-agent orchestration (run_workflow DAG + /swarm) │ ├── prd/SKILL.md # Dependency-aware PRD authoring skill │ └── prd-to-loop/SKILL.md # PRD -> validated prd.json DAG converter skill ├── scripts/ │ ├── loop_core.py # Shared stdlib-only Python 3 core (zero external deps) │ ├── stop-hook.py # Antigravity Stop hook (Dual-Gate + CB + context ceiling) │ ├── guard-hook.py # Active-loop PreToolUse safety guard │ ├── loop-ctl.py # CLI: start, status, cancel, reset-cb, takeover, waves │ ├── floating-loop.sh # External fresh-context agy -p runner (prd/prompt/autoresearch) │ ├── prompts/ # Iteration, autoresearch, and role-hat prompt templates │ └── workflows/ │ └── floating_swarm.py # Native `run_workflow` parallel worktree DAG + verifier ├── schemas/prd.schema.json # JSON Schema for enhanced prd.json ├── examples/prd.json.example # Multi-wave example PRD ├── tests/ # Automated unit, hook, swarm, and CLI integration tests └── .agents/skills.json # Local workspace pointer to root `skills/` (zero duplication) ``` --- ## Safety & Security - **Active-Loop `PreToolUse` Guardrail**: Zero-overhead passthrough outside active loops; during an active loop, blocks catastrophic `rm -rf`, `git push --force`, unauthorized `git reset --hard`, and direct `.floating-loop/sessions/` edits. - **PRD Anti-Tampering**: Snapshots `prd.json` before every iteration and restores it if story IDs are removed, corrupted, or non-target stories are marked complete. - **Bounded Execution**: Always configure `--max-iterations` and `--cb-threshold`. Run unattended `--dangerously-skip-permissions` loops (Mode B) only on dedicated feature branches or isolated sandboxes. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for full details and vulnerability reporting. --- ## Running Tests Offline strict plugin validation, syntax checks, Python unit/hook/swarm tests, and mocked CLI integration tests: ```bash bash tests/run_all.sh ``` Live end-to-end tests against the real `agy` CLI (Stop hook + Dual-Gate, external PRD loop, and Autoresearch keep-or-revert): ```bash bash tests/test_e2e_live.sh --model gemini-3.8-flash-low ``` --- ## Contributing & Changelog - Contributions are welcome! Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for architecture invariants and verification commands. - See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for release history. ## Acknowledgments Inspired by [Geoff Huntley's Ralph Wiggum technique](https://ghuntley.com/ralph/), `snarktank/ralph`, `claude-ralph-loop`, and Andrej Karpathy's autoresearch keep-or-revert workflow. ## License Released under the [MIT License](LICENSE).
latestReleaseNotes:
## [0.1.1] - 2026-11-26

### Fixed
- CI Python syntax check now compiles `scripts/workflows/floating_swarm.py` with `ast.PyCF_ALLOW_TOP_LEVEL_AWAIT`. The intentional top-level `await` (Antigravity `run_workflow` injects an async runtime) no longer fails `python3 -m py_compile` on `ubuntu-latest` and `macos-latest`. The await itself is unchanged.

### Changed
- Replaced `assets/logo.svg` with a transparent 128×128 woven infinity ribbon (cyan `#38BDF8` to purple `#C084FC`). `plugin.json` `logo` stays `assets/logo.svg`.
- README install instructions now include the partner Marketplace id `floating-loop@antigravity-plugins-partners`, the App deep link, and the Antigravity CLI download docs. License remains MIT.
